items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I remember this one brochure I had and they asked Benny Goodman and Louis Armstrong and Doc Severinsen... what do you look for in a drummer?

ctx.x: Is it possible to tell younger players what makes things swing?

Well I know from some teaching that I do that when I hear somebody who just has the innate quality of knowing where the pulse is, sometimes I want to say you can’t teach somebody to swing. Sometimes I say maybe you can. But I think everyone has this level of the ability to hear the full value of a quarter note let’s say. And then some of them, you know make it stretch and breathe and time does expand and contract. We’re not robots so it’s not metronomic. I’d rather swing than play steady. Dig that. Because if…
Is it hard to play with a click track because of that, time expanding and—
